wasm_compile.scope: Local offline/locked compile check only for core, data, scene physics at wasm32-unknown-unknown.

cli_prospective_static_review.scope: Static source-informed contract review only; actual binary/source/lock binding and fifteen individual command results require separate evidence.

limits: Compile check does not establish WASM runtime/browser behavior or CLI/WASM integration acceptance.
Existing ignored native caches/build artifacts remain qualified, not independently checksum verified.
CLI rates require finite accounting and activity; no empirical magnitudes or chemical accuracy forecast. 1500 K does not imply overlap of all published validity ranges.
Inert bounded trajectory avoids active stiff combustion and establishes no active integration accuracy.
Collector requires binary SHA and limited source hashes; reviewer must separately verify full source/lock/build provenance before execution acceptance.
Public parser dependency error payload changes and hosted CI/fleet/integration remain separately scoped.
